arms.pinned: session file pins (compiler + every policy entry + gate + policy), no rehash, no monitor
arms.monitored: same pins plus debug-event execution gate with staged read-locked source

design.isolated_factor: monitored - pinned differs only in the monitoring step (gated launch + staged source)
design.order: six permutations of the three arms rotated by revision; each pairwise order occurs equally often

peak_memory_note: launched_peak_kib is PeakWorkingSetSize of the directly launched process: the compiler/linker for rehash and pinned, but the gate process for monitored. It is therefore NOT a comparable peak-memory measurement across arms.
